category: status pages with uptime monitoring and on-call alerting

free_tier.stated: Starter plan, free: 15 monitors at a 2-minute check interval, email alerts, 5 team members, 2 on-call members and a public status page with 200 subscribers; no custom domain
free_tier.notes: The unit counted is the monitor. The pricing text read shows the Starter plan as Free and leaves the Pro and Business prices blank, so no paid price is recorded. Which plans include the API is not stated on the pricing page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a monitor checks a target; nothing is stored per object

retention.stated: unverified: no history retention period is stated on the pricing page

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker and a status page host; incidents and page data are read through the REST API

interface_detail: A REST API at api.instatus.com takes JSON and an API token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header, created in the dashboard under User settings, Developer settings. Whether the Starter plan may use it is unverified: the pricing page lists no API row.
tooling: the web dashboard and the REST API
chaining: A public status page and 2-minute checks on up to 15 endpoints of free-hosted services, with incidents opened and updated through the API.

limits.value: 15 monitors, 5 team members, 2 on-call members and 200 subscribers on Starter
2-minute check interval on Starter, 30 seconds on Pro and Business

limits_note: Starter alerts by email only, while Pro adds SMS and Business adds calls; a custom domain starts on Pro.
binding_note: The 15-monitor cap and the 200-subscriber cap fill before the 2-minute check interval matters for an app with a few endpoints.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page text shows Continue with Google behind an hCaptcha and an agreement to the terms; whether an email and password form exists, and whether a card or phone number is asked later, is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page and the API from its documentation. No account was opened, so the sign-up fields, the card term and the API access on Starter are unverified: behind a sign-up.

evidence.proved: Starter has 15 monitors against 50 on Pro and 1,000 on Business
Starter alerts by email, Pro by email and SMS, Business by SMS and calls
